{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check unique values in 'status' column
status_counts = sales_df['status'].value_counts()

# Check if 'revenue' is numeric
revenue_dtype = sales_df['revenue'].dtype

# Check for invalid revenue values (e.g., negative or non-numeric)
invalid_revenue = sales_df[~pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce').notna()]

print("Missing values:", missing_values)
print("\nStatus value counts:\n", status_counts)
print("\nRevenue dtype:", revenue_dtype)
print("\nInvalid revenue rows:\n", invalid_revenue)"}
